pattern.zh: 三指针荷兰国旗划分
pattern.en: Three-pointer Dutch flag partition

when.zh: 数组里只有三种值（0/1/2，或「小于 / 等于 / 大于 pivot」）要原地分成三段：lo 左边全是 0，hi 右边全是 2，i 扫中间；和 hi 交换后 i 不前进，因为换过来的值还没看过。LC 75 颜色分类就是它，快排的三路划分也是。
when.en: When the array holds three kinds of values (0/1/2, or less / equal / greater than a pivot) to split into three runs in place: everything left of lo is 0, right of hi is 2, and i scans the middle. After swapping with hi, i stays put because the value it received is unchecked. LC 75 (Sort Colors) is this, and so is quicksort's three-way partition.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

pattern.zh: 原地哈希：把值 v 换到下标 v - 1
pattern.en: In-place hashing: swap value v to index v - 1

when.zh: 值落在 1..n 之间、要求 O(1) 额外空间找缺失或重复的数：把每个值反复换到它「该在」的位置，之后再扫一遍，第一个不在家的位置就是答案。LC 41 缺失的第一个正数、LC 448、LC 442、LC 645 都是这个形状。
when.en: When values lie in 1..n and a missing or repeated number must be found with O(1) extra space: keep swapping each value into its home slot, then scan once; the first slot not holding its own value is the answer. LC 41 (First Missing Positive), LC 448, LC 442 and LC 645 share this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n)（每次交换让一个值归位）· 空间 O(1)
complexity.en: O(n) time (each swap homes one value) · O(1) space

pattern.zh: Kadane：以当前元素结尾的最大和
pattern.en: Kadane: best sum ending at the current element

when.zh: 求和最大的连续子数组（LC 53）：只记「以当前元素结尾」的最好和，它要么接上前面，要么从自己重新开始；全局答案取历史最大。全是负数时答案是最大的那个负数，所以初值用 nums[0] 而不是 0。
when.en: For the largest-sum contiguous subarray (LC 53): keep only the best sum ending at the current element, which either extends the previous one or restarts at itself, and take the best seen. With all negatives the answer is the largest negative, so start from nums[0], not 0.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
def max_subarray(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    """Largest sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray."""
    best = cur = nums[0]  # cur: best sum of a subarray ending at the current element
    for x in nums[1:]:
        cur = max(x, cur + x)  # extend, or start over at x
        best = max(best, cur)
    return best

pattern.zh: 按规范键分组
pattern.en: Group by a canonical key

when.zh: 要把「本质相同」的元素归到一起（字母异位词、移位字符串、同构）：给每个元素算一个规范键，相同键进同一组。键可以是排序后的字母，也可以是 26 个计数拼成的字符串。LC 49 字母异位词分组、LC 249 移位字符串分组。
when.en: When elements that are the same in some sense must be grouped (anagrams, shifted strings, isomorphic words): compute a canonical key per element and bucket by it. The key can be the sorted letters or the 26 letter counts joined. LC 49 (Group Anagrams) and LC 249 (Group Shifted Strings).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · L log L) · 空间 O(n · L)
complexity.en: O(n · L log L) time · O(n · L) space

code.python:
def group_anagrams(words: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
    """Words grouped by anagram class, groups in order of first appearance."""
    index: dict[str, int] = {}  # canonical key -> position of its group
    groups: list[list[str]] = []
    for w in words:
        key = "".join(sorted(w))  # anagrams share their sorted letters
        if key not in index:
            index[key] = len(groups)
            groups.append([])
        groups[index[key]].append(w)
    return groups

pattern.zh: 哈希集合：只从连续段的起点往后数
pattern.en: Hash set: count runs only from their starts

when.zh: 要在 O(n) 里找最长的连续整数段（LC 128），不能排序：把数放进集合，只有 x - 1 不在集合里时 x 才是段的起点，从起点往后数。每个数最多被数两次，所以是线性的。
when.en: For the longest run of consecutive integers in O(n) (LC 128), without sorting: put the numbers in a set, and treat x as a run start only when x - 1 is absent, then count upwards from it. Each number is touched at most twice, so it stays linear.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

pattern.zh: Rabin-Karp 滚动哈希
pattern.en: Rabin-Karp rolling hash

when.zh: 要快速比较很多个等长子串（找重复子串、最长重复子串二分长度、回文前缀）时，用多项式哈希：窗口右移一位，减掉离开字符的贡献、乘基数、加上新字符，O(1) 更新。哈希相等还要逐字确认，防碰撞。LC 28、LC 1044、LC 214 都能用它。
when.en: When many equal-length substrings must be compared quickly (repeated substrings, binary searching the length of the longest repeat, palindromic prefixes), use a polynomial hash: sliding the window drops the leaving character's share, multiplies by the base and adds the new one, all in O(1). Confirm a hash hit character by character, since collisions happen. LC 28, LC 1044 and LC 214 can use it.

complexity.zh: 期望时间 O(n + m) · 空间 O(1)
complexity.en: Expected O(n + m) time · O(1) space

code.python:
def rabin_karp(text: str, pat: str) -> list[int]:
    """Start of every occurrence of a non-empty pat, found with rolling hashes."""
    MOD, BASE = 1_000_000_007, 131
    n, m = len(text), len(pat)
    if m > n:
        return []
    top = pow(BASE, m - 1, MOD)  # weight of the character leaving the window
    hp = hw = 0
    for i in range(m):
        hp = (hp * BASE + ord(pat[i])) % MOD
        hw = (hw * BASE + ord(text[i])) % MOD
    res = []
    for i in range(n - m + 1):
        if hw == hp and text[i : i + m] == pat:  # confirm a hit: hashes can collide
            res.append(i)
        if i + m < n:  # roll: drop text[i], add text[i + m]
            hw = ((hw - ord(text[i]) * top) * BASE + ord(text[i + m])) % MOD
    return res

pattern.zh: 先整体反转，再逐词反转
pattern.en: Reverse the whole, then each word

when.zh: 要求原地（O(1) 额外空间）调整单词顺序：先用读写指针压掉多余空格，把每个词反转，最后整体反转一次，词序就倒过来、词内顺序又正回来。LC 151 反转字符串中的单词；LC 344、LC 345、LC 917 是其中的双指针反转。
when.en: When word order must change in place (O(1) extra space): squeeze out extra spaces with read and write pointers, reverse each word, then reverse everything once, which flips the word order while turning each word the right way round again. LC 151 (Reverse Words in a String); LC 344, LC 345 and LC 917 are the two-pointer reversal inside it.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)（Python 字符串不可变，借一个字符列表）
complexity.en: O(n) time · O(1) space (a char list in Python, whose strings are immutable)

pattern.zh: 定长滑动窗口
pattern.en: Fixed-size sliding window

when.zh: 窗口长度 k 固定（长度为 k 的子串里元素最多、某个排列是否出现）：右端每进一个，左端 i - k 就出一个，窗口满 k 之后才开始记答案。LC 1456、LC 438 找到字符串中所有字母异位词、LC 567 字符串的排列都是这个形状。
when.en: When the window length k is fixed (the most of something in a length-k substring, whether a permutation occurs): each element that enters on the right pushes out the one at i - k, and answers count only once the window holds k. LC 1456, LC 438 (Find All Anagrams in a String) and LC 567 (Permutation in String) have this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
def max_vowels(s: str, k: int) -> int:
    """Most vowels in any length-k substring (LC 1456)."""
    vowels = set("aeiou")
    cur = best = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(s):
        cur += c in vowels  # c enters the window
        if i >= k:
            cur -= s[i - k] in vowels  # s[i - k] leaves: the window is s[i-k+1..i]
        if i >= k - 1:  # only full windows count
            best = max(best, cur)
    return best

pattern.zh: 相向双指针：每次移动较短的一边
pattern.en: Two pointers from both ends: move the shorter side

when.zh: 答案由两端共同决定、而且可以证明「较差的那一端」不可能再参与更好的答案时，用两个指针从两头往中间收。LC 11 盛最多水的容器每次移动较矮的墙；LC 167、LC 15 三数之和在有序数组上按和的大小移动。
when.en: When the answer depends on both ends and the worse end provably cannot take part in a better answer, close in from both ends. LC 11 (Container With Most Water) moves the shorter wall each time; LC 167 and LC 15 (3Sum) move by comparing the sum on a sorted array.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
def max_area(height: list[int]) -> int:
    """Most water two walls can hold (LC 11)."""
    lo, hi = 0, len(height) - 1
    best = 0
    while lo < hi:
        best = max(best, (hi - lo) * min(height[lo], height[hi]))
        if height[lo] < height[hi]:  # the shorter wall caps every narrower pair it is in
            lo += 1
        else:
            hi -= 1
    return best

pattern.zh: 恰好 K 个 = 至多 K 个 − 至多 K−1 个
pattern.en: Exactly K = at most K − at most K−1

when.zh: 要数「恰好 K 个不同值 / 恰好 K 个奇数 / 和恰好为 K」的子数组，窗口不满足单调收缩；但「至多 K 个」满足：右端每到一个位置，以它结尾的合法窗口有 right - left + 1 个。两次相减得到恰好 K。LC 992、LC 930、LC 1248 都这么做。
when.en: Counting subarrays with exactly K distinct values (or exactly K odd numbers, or sum exactly K) does not shrink monotonically, but at most K does: at each right end, right - left + 1 valid windows end there. Subtract two such counts to get exactly K. LC 992, LC 930 and LC 1248 work this way.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
from collections import defaultdict


def subarrays_with_k_distinct(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """Subarrays with exactly k distinct values (LC 992)."""

    def at_most(k: int) -> int:  # subarrays with at most k distinct values
        cnt = defaultdict(int)
        left = total = 0
        for right, x in enumerate(nums):
            cnt[x] += 1
            if cnt[x] == 1:
                k -= 1
            while k < 0:  # one distinct value too many: shrink from the left
                cnt[nums[left]] -= 1
                if cnt[nums[left]] == 0:
                    k += 1
                left += 1
            total += right - left + 1  # windows that end at right and start at or after left
        return total

    return at_most(k) - at_most(k - 1)

pattern.zh: 差分数组：区间加，最后一次前缀和
pattern.en: Difference array: range adds, one prefix sum at the end

when.zh: 很多次「给区间 [l, r] 加 v」、最后才要结果：在 diff[l] 加 v、diff[r + 1] 减 v，每次 O(1)，最后求一遍前缀和还原数组。LC 1094 拼车、LC 1109 航班预订统计、LC 370 区间加法都是这样。
when.en: Many updates of the form add v to [l, r] with the result needed only at the end: add v at diff[l] and subtract it at diff[r + 1], O(1) each, then one prefix sum rebuilds the array. LC 1094 (Car Pooling), LC 1109 (Corporate Flight Bookings) and LC 370 (Range Addition) work this way.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n + q) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
def range_add(n: int, updates: list[tuple[int, int, int]]) -> list[int]:
    """n zeros, then each (l, r, v) adds v to positions l..r (LC 370)."""
    diff = [0] * (n + 1)  # diff[i] = a[i] - a[i - 1]; the extra slot takes r + 1 = n
    for l, r, v in updates:
        diff[l] += v
        diff[r + 1] -= v  # the change stops after r
    res, run = [], 0
    for i in range(n):
        run += diff[i]  # prefix sums of the differences rebuild the array
        res.append(run)
    return res

pattern.zh: 二维前缀和：容斥求子矩形和
pattern.en: 2-D prefix sums: rectangle sums by inclusion-exclusion

when.zh: 矩阵不变、要反复问子矩形的和：pre[r][c] 存左上角 r × c 块的和，多开一行一列 0 免去边界判断；查询时用四个角容斥，O(1)。LC 304 二维区域和检索、LC 1314 矩阵区域和，LC 1074 在它上面再套一维哈希。
when.en: When a fixed matrix gets many sub-rectangle sum queries: pre[r][c] holds the sum of the top-left r × c block, with an extra zero row and column so edges need no checks, and each query is four corners by inclusion-exclusion in O(1). LC 304 (Range Sum Query 2D), LC 1314 (Matrix Block Sum); LC 1074 adds a hash map on top.

complexity.zh: 预处理 O(rows × cols) · 查询 O(1)
complexity.en: O(rows × cols) setup · O(1) per query

pattern.zh: 按起点排序，合并重叠区间
pattern.en: Sort by start, merge overlaps

when.zh: 要把区间并起来（合并、插入、求交、算总覆盖长度）：按起点排序后，新区间的起点不超过上一个结果的终点就合并、终点取较大者，否则另起一段。LC 56 合并区间、LC 57 插入区间、LC 986 区间列表的交集都从这里出发。
when.en: For the union of intervals (merging, inserting, intersecting, total covered length): sort by start, and when a new interval starts no later than the last merged one ends, extend that one to the larger end; otherwise start a new run. LC 56 (Merge Intervals), LC 57 (Insert Interval) and LC 986 (Interval List Intersections) start here.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n log n) · 空间 O(n)
complexity.en: O(n log n) time · O(n) space

pattern.zh: 二分答案：在答案区间上找第一个可行值
pattern.en: Binary search on the answer

when.zh: 题目要「最小的可行速度 / 容量 / 天数」，而且可行性随答案单调（速度越快越吃得完）：直接在答案的取值范围上二分，每次用一个 O(n) 的检查函数判断 mid 行不行。LC 875 爱吃香蕉的珂珂、LC 1011、LC 410 都是这个形状。
when.en: When the question asks for the smallest workable speed, capacity or day count, and workability is monotone in the answer (a faster speed always finishes), binary search the range of answers and test each mid with an O(n) check. LC 875 (Koko Eating Bananas), LC 1011 and LC 410 have this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n log M)，M 是答案范围 · 空间 O(1)
complexity.en: O(n log M) time, M the answer range · O(1) space

pattern.zh: 旋转数组：先判断哪一半有序
pattern.en: Rotated array: find the sorted half first

when.zh: 有序数组被旋转过一次（LC 33、LC 153），整体不再单调，但 mid 两边至少有一半有序：先看 nums[lo] <= nums[mid] 判断左半有序，再看 target 落不落在有序那一半里。用闭区间 [lo, hi]，找到就返回。
when.en: A sorted array rotated once (LC 33, LC 153) is no longer monotone, but at least one half around mid is sorted: nums[lo] <= nums[mid] means the left half is, and then the target either falls inside that sorted half or it does not. Use the closed range [lo, hi] and return on a hit.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(log n) · 空间 O(1)

pattern.zh: 找峰值：和右邻居比坡度
pattern.en: Peak finding: compare with the right neighbour

when.zh: 数组没有整体有序，但相邻元素不相等时，往上坡走一定能走到峰：nums[mid] < nums[mid + 1] 说明右边有峰，否则 mid 或它左边有峰。LC 162 寻找峰值、LC 852 山脉数组的峰顶都用这一比较。
when.en: Without global order but with adjacent elements distinct, walking uphill always reaches a peak: nums[mid] < nums[mid + 1] puts a peak on the right, otherwise mid or something left of it is one. LC 162 (Find Peak Element) and LC 852 (Peak Index in a Mountain Array) use this comparison.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(log n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
def find_peak(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    """Index of an element larger than its neighbours (LC 162); adjacent values differ."""
    lo, hi = 0, len(nums) - 1
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if nums[mid] < nums[mid + 1]:  # uphill to the right: a peak lies in (mid, hi]
            lo = mid + 1
        else:  # downhill: mid or something left of it is a peak
            hi = mid
    return lo

pattern.zh: 单调队列：滑动窗口最大值
pattern.en: Monotonic deque: sliding window maximum

when.zh: 窗口在滑、要随时拿到窗口里的最大（或最小）值：双端队列里存下标、对应值从头到尾递减；新元素从尾部挤掉比它小的，队头滑出窗口就弹掉，队头永远是最大值。LC 239 滑动窗口最大值；LC 862 在前缀和上用同一个队列。
when.en: When a sliding window must always know its maximum (or minimum): a deque of indexes whose values decrease from front to back. A new element pushes smaller ones off the back, the front is dropped once it slides out, and the front is always the maximum. LC 239 (Sliding Window Maximum); LC 862 uses the same deque over prefix sums.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n)（每个下标进出队列各一次）· 空间 O(k)
complexity.en: O(n) time (each index enters and leaves once) · O(k) space

pattern.zh: 大小为 k 的小顶堆求第 k 大
pattern.en: Size-k min-heap for the k-th largest

when.zh: 只关心最大的 k 个（第 k 大、前 k 个高频、数据流里的第 k 大）：维护一个大小为 k 的小顶堆，堆顶是这 k 个里最弱的；新值比堆顶大才替换。比整体排序省，O(n log k)。LC 215 数组中的第 K 个最大元素、LC 703、LC 373。
when.en: When only the k largest matter (the k-th largest, the top k frequent, the k-th largest in a stream): keep a min-heap of size k whose top is the weakest of them, and replace it only when a new value beats it. Cheaper than sorting everything: O(n log k). LC 215 (Kth Largest Element in an Array), LC 703, LC 373.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n log k) · 空间 O(k)
complexity.en: O(n log k) time · O(k) space

pattern.zh: 表达式求值：乘除立刻结算，加减入栈
pattern.en: Expression stack: fold * and / at once, push + and -

when.zh: 计算只有 + - * / 的表达式（LC 227 基本计算器 II）：读完一个数时看它前面的运算符，加减把带符号的数压栈，乘除直接和栈顶算掉；最后把栈里的数加起来。有括号的 LC 224、LC 772 是遇到括号时递归或再压一层。
when.en: To evaluate + - * / without parentheses (LC 227, Basic Calculator II): when a number ends, look at the operator before it; + and - push the signed number, * and / fold it into the top at once, and the answer is the sum of the stack. LC 224 and LC 772 add parentheses by recursing or pushing a level per bracket.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

pattern.zh: 最远可达边界：一层一层地跳
pattern.en: Reach frontier: jump level by level

when.zh: 每个位置给出能跳多远，问能不能到终点或最少跳几次：边走边更新「下一跳最远能到哪」，走到当前这一跳的边界时跳数加一、边界换成最远处。这其实是不建队列的 BFS。LC 45 跳跃游戏 II；LC 55 只要判断最远处是否一直不落后于 i。
when.en: When each position says how far it can jump and the question is whether the end is reachable or how few jumps it takes: track how far the next jump could reach, and when i hits the current jump's boundary, count a jump and move the boundary there. It is BFS without a queue. LC 45 (Jump Game II); LC 55 only checks that the reach never falls behind i.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
def min_jumps(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    """Fewest jumps from index 0 to the last; nums[i] is the longest jump from i (LC 45)."""
    jumps = end = far = 0  # indexes up to end take `jumps` jumps; far: the next jump's reach
    for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
        far = max(far, i + nums[i])
        if i == end:  # this jump's range is used up: take another
            jumps += 1
            end = far
    return jumps

pattern.zh: 反悔堆：先选上，超了再踢掉最差的
pattern.en: Regret heap: take it, then drop the worst when over

when.zh: 按截止时间（或位置）扫描，每样东西先选上，一旦超出限制，就从已选的里踢掉代价最大的那个，用堆在 O(log n) 里找到它。LC 630 课程表 III、LC 1642 可以到达的最远建筑、LC 871 最低加油次数都是这种「可以反悔」的贪心。
when.en: Scan by deadline (or position), take each item at first, and when a limit is broken, drop the costliest item taken so far, found in O(log n) with a heap. LC 630 (Course Schedule III), LC 1642 (Furthest Building You Can Reach) and LC 871 (Minimum Number of Refueling Stops) are this take-back greedy.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n log n) · 空间 O(n)
complexity.en: O(n log n) time · O(n) space

code.python:
import heapq


def schedule_course(courses: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    """Most courses [duration, last day] you can finish one at a time (LC 630)."""
    taken: list[int] = []  # chosen durations as a max-heap (negated)
    day = 0
    for duration, last in sorted(courses, key=lambda c: c[1]):  # earliest deadline first
        heapq.heappush(taken, -duration)
        day += duration
        if day > last:  # past the deadline: drop the longest course taken so far
            day += heapq.heappop(taken)
    return len(taken)

pattern.zh: 哑结点 + 尾指针拼接新链表
pattern.en: Dummy head and a tail pointer to splice a new list

when.zh: 要边走边拼出一条新链表（合并、分区、两数相加、删除）：先放一个哑结点，尾指针 tail 只往后接，头结点就不用特判，最后返回 dummy.next。LC 21 合并两个有序链表、LC 2 两数相加、LC 86 分隔链表都是这个形状。
when.en: When a new list is spliced together on the way (merging, partitioning, adding numbers, deleting): start from a dummy node and only ever append at a tail pointer, so the head needs no special case, then return dummy.next. LC 21 (Merge Two Sorted Lists), LC 2 (Add Two Numbers) and LC 86 (Partition List) have this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(m + n) · 空间 O(1)

pattern.zh: 按 k 个一组反转
pattern.en: Reverse in groups of k

when.zh: 只反转链表的一段或一组一组地反转：prev 停在这一组前面，先数够 k 个（不够就保持原样），在组内原地反转，再把组头组尾接回去，prev 移到这组的新尾巴。LC 25 K 个一组翻转链表、LC 24 两两交换（k = 2）、LC 92 反转链表 II 都是这个骨架。
when.en: To reverse one segment or the list group by group: prev waits before the group, count k nodes first (fewer stay as they are), reverse the group in place, reconnect both ends, and move prev to the group's new tail. LC 25 (Reverse Nodes in k-Group), LC 24 (Swap Nodes in Pairs, k = 2) and LC 92 (Reverse Linked List II) share this skeleton.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val, self.next = val, next


def reverse_k_group(head, k: int):
    """Reverses every full group of k nodes; a shorter tail stays as it is (LC 25)."""
    dummy = ListNode(0, head)
    prev = dummy  # the node before the group being reversed
    while True:
        tail = prev
        for _ in range(k):  # is there a full group after prev?
            tail = tail.next
            if not tail:
                return dummy.next
        nxt, cur, p = tail.next, prev.next, tail.next
        while cur is not nxt:  # reverse prev.next..tail, hanging it onto nxt
            cur.next, p, cur = p, cur, cur.next
        first = prev.next  # the group's old first node is now its last
        prev.next = tail
        prev = first

pattern.zh: 后序求高度，用 -1 表示「已经不平衡」
pattern.en: Postorder heights, with -1 for "already unbalanced"

when.zh: 判断要用到子树信息（是否平衡、高度、直径）时，后序遍历让每个结点先拿到左右子树的结果再算自己；用 -1 这种不可能的高度把「失败」一路传上去，不必再算一遍。LC 110 平衡二叉树、LC 104 最大深度、LC 543 二叉树的直径都是这个形状。
when.en: When a check needs facts about subtrees (balance, height, diameter), a postorder walk hands each node its children's results before it computes its own, and an impossible height such as -1 carries a failure straight up without recomputing anything. LC 110 (Balanced Binary Tree), LC 104 (Maximum Depth) and LC 543 (Diameter of Binary Tree) have this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 递归深度 O(h)

pattern.zh: 用栈迭代：前序，以及反转得到后序
pattern.en: Iterative with a stack: preorder, and postorder by reversal

when.zh: 树很深、怕递归爆栈，或者面试官要求不用递归：前序用一个栈，先压右孩子再压左孩子；后序按「根、右、左」走一遍再整体反转。中序的迭代写法见二叉搜索树那一站。LC 144、LC 145、LC 94。
when.en: When the tree may be too deep to recurse, or the interviewer rules recursion out: preorder uses one stack, pushing the right child before the left; postorder walks root, right, left and reverses the result. The iterative inorder is at the binary search tree stop. LC 144, LC 145, LC 94.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(h)～O(n)
complexity.en: O(n) time · O(h) to O(n) space

pattern.zh: 树上前缀和：回溯时撤销计数
pattern.en: Prefix sums on a tree: undo the count on the way back

when.zh: 数「向下的路径」里和为 target 的有几条，路径可以从任意结点开始：把根到当前结点的前缀和放进哈希表，像数组上的「和为 K 的子数组」一样查 pre - target；离开结点时把自己的前缀和计数减掉，别的分支才看不到它。LC 437 路径总和 III。
when.en: To count downward paths that sum to target, starting anywhere: keep the root-to-node prefix sums in a hash map and look up pre - target, as in Subarray Sum Equals K; on leaving a node, remove its prefix so other branches never see it. LC 437 (Path Sum III).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(h)

code.python:
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val, self.left, self.right = val, left, right

from collections import defaultdict


def path_sum_count(root, target: int) -> int:
    """Downward paths, starting and ending anywhere, whose values sum to target (LC 437)."""
    seen = defaultdict(int)  # prefix sums on the current root-to-node path
    seen[0] = 1
    count = 0

    def dfs(node, pre: int) -> None:
        nonlocal count
        if not node:
            return
        pre += node.val
        count += seen[pre - target]  # a path ending here starts after an ancestor's prefix
        seen[pre] += 1
        dfs(node.left, pre)
        dfs(node.right, pre)
        seen[pre] -= 1  # leaving node: its prefix is off the path now

    dfs(root, 0)
    return count

pattern.zh: 最近公共祖先：两边都找到就是这里
pattern.en: Lowest common ancestor: found on both sides means here

when.zh: 问两个结点在哪里「汇合」：递归在左右子树里找 p 和 q，碰到其中一个就把它往上交；某个结点左右两边都交上来了，它就是最近公共祖先，否则把非空的那一边继续往上交。LC 236 二叉树的最近公共祖先，LC 1644、LC 1650 是它的变形。
when.en: To find where two nodes meet: search both subtrees for p and q and hand either one upwards as soon as it is found; a node that receives results from both sides is the lowest common ancestor, and otherwise it passes on whichever side is non-empty. LC 236 (Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree); LC 1644 and LC 1650 are variations.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 递归深度 O(h)

pattern.zh: 中序 + 后序建树：倒着读后序
pattern.en: Inorder + postorder: read postorder backwards

when.zh: 给的是中序和后序（LC 106）：后序倒过来读就是「根、右、左」，所以每次取下一个根以后要先建右子树、再建左子树；中序里根的位置照样用哈希表 O(1) 找到，把区间切成两半。
when.en: Given inorder and postorder (LC 106): postorder read backwards is root, right, left, so after taking each root build the right subtree before the left. The root's inorder position still comes from a hash map in O(1) and splits the range in two.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

pattern.zh: 单调栈一遍建最大二叉树
pattern.en: Monotonic stack builds a maximum tree in one pass

when.zh: 「每个子树的根是区间最大值」这类建树（LC 654 最大二叉树，也就是笛卡尔树）：递归每次找最大值是 O(n²)；用一个值递减的栈只要 O(n)，新结点把比它小的结点弹出挂成左子树，自己挂到栈顶更大的结点右边。
when.en: For trees whose every subtree root is the maximum of its range (LC 654, Maximum Binary Tree, a Cartesian tree): recursing to find each maximum is O(n²), while a stack with decreasing values takes O(n). Each new node pops the smaller nodes as its left subtree and hangs itself to the right of the larger node left on top.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

pattern.zh: 上下界递归：每个结点落在祖先给的开区间里
pattern.en: Bounds recursion: each node inside the range its ancestors set

when.zh: 只和父结点比较不够（右子树深处的小值也违规）：递归时带着 (lo, hi) 开区间往下传，走左边把上界收成当前值，走右边把下界收成当前值。LC 98 验证二叉搜索树；用 long 或无穷大做初始边界，防止结点值等于 int 极值。
when.en: Comparing with the parent is not enough (a small value deep in a right subtree breaks the rule too): pass an open range (lo, hi) down, tightening the upper bound to the current value on the left and the lower bound on the right. LC 98 (Validate Binary Search Tree); start from long or infinite bounds in case a node holds the int extremes.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 递归深度 O(h)

pattern.zh: 删除结点：两个孩子时换成中序后继
pattern.en: Delete a node: swap in the inorder successor when it has two children

when.zh: 在 BST 里删除或修剪（LC 450 删除二叉搜索树中的节点、LC 669 修剪）：按大小往一边递归，返回新的子树根接回父结点；要删的结点最多一个孩子时直接把孩子提上来，两个孩子时把右子树最小值（中序后继）的值拷过来，再去右子树里删掉它。
when.en: For deleting from or trimming a BST (LC 450, Delete Node in a BST; LC 669, Trim a BST): recurse to one side by value and return the new subtree root for the parent to reattach. A node with at most one child is replaced by that child; with two, copy the smallest value of its right subtree (the inorder successor) and delete that value from the right subtree.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(h) · 递归深度 O(h)

pattern.zh: 显式栈 DFS 洪水填充
pattern.en: Flood fill with an explicit-stack DFS

when.zh: 数连通块、算面积、给一块区域换颜色：从一个没访问过的格子出发，把四个方向上同类的格子都标掉。用显式栈代替递归，大岛屿不会爆栈；入栈时就标记，同一格不会进栈两次。LC 200 岛屿数量、LC 695 岛屿的最大面积、LC 733 图像渲染。
when.en: To count regions, measure their area or recolour one: start from an unvisited cell and mark every same-kind cell reachable in four directions. An explicit stack instead of recursion survives huge islands, and marking on push keeps any cell from being pushed twice. LC 200 (Number of Islands), LC 695 (Max Area of Island), LC 733 (Flood Fill).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(rows × cols) · 空间 O(rows × cols)
complexity.en: O(rows × cols) time · O(rows × cols) space

code.python:
def island_stats(grid: list[list[int]]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """(number of islands, largest island area) in a 0/1 grid (LC 200, LC 695)."""
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = [[False] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    count = best = 0
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != 1 or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            count += 1
            area, stack = 0, [(r, c)]
            seen[r][c] = True
            while stack:  # an explicit stack: no recursion limit on big islands
                i, j = stack.pop()
                area += 1
                for ni, nj in ((i + 1, j), (i - 1, j), (i, j + 1), (i, j - 1)):
                    if 0 <= ni < rows and 0 <= nj < cols and grid[ni][nj] == 1 and not seen[ni][nj]:
                        seen[ni][nj] = True  # mark on push: no cell goes in twice
                        stack.append((ni, nj))
            best = max(best, area)
    return count, best

pattern.zh: 带状态的网格 BFS：(行, 列, 剩余次数)
pattern.en: Grid BFS with state: (row, col, uses left)

when.zh: 走格子时还带着别的资源（还能打穿几堵墙、手里有哪些钥匙）：状态变成 (r, c, 资源)，按层 BFS 仍然给出最少步数。同一格只在「剩余资源比以前多」时才值得再进队，这一条剪枝让状态数降下来。LC 1293 网格中的最短路径。
when.en: When moving through a grid also spends something (walls you may still break, keys in hand), the state becomes (r, c, resource), and level-by-level BFS still gives the fewest steps. Revisit a cell only when you arrive with more of the resource left than before; that pruning keeps the state count down. LC 1293 (Shortest Path in a Grid with Obstacles Elimination).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(rows × cols × k) · 空间 O(rows × cols × k)
complexity.en: O(rows × cols × k) time · O(rows × cols × k) space

code.python:
from collections import deque


def shortest_with_breaks(grid: list[list[int]], k: int) -> int:
    """Fewest steps from top-left to bottom-right, breaking at most k walls (LC 1293)."""
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    best = [[-1] * cols for _ in range(rows)]  # most breaks still in hand on reaching a cell
    best[0][0] = k
    q = deque([(0, 0, k)])  # a state is (r, c, breaks left)
    steps = 0
    while q:
        for _ in range(len(q)):  # one BFS level per step
            r, c, left = q.popleft()
            if r == rows - 1 and c == cols - 1:
                return steps
            for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c), (r - 1, c), (r, c + 1), (r, c - 1)):
                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                    rest = left - grid[nr][nc]
                    if rest > best[nr][nc]:  # more breaks left than any earlier visit: worth it
                        best[nr][nc] = rest
                        q.append((nr, nc, rest))
        steps += 1
    return -1

pattern.zh: BFS 二染色判二分图
pattern.en: Two-colouring by BFS for bipartiteness

when.zh: 要把点分成两组、每条边都跨组（二分图、「不喜欢」的人分开）：BFS 给相邻点涂相反的颜色，遇到同色的邻居就是奇环，答案为否。图可能不连通，每个没染色的点都要当一次起点。LC 785 判断二分图、LC 886 可能的二分法。
when.en: When nodes must split into two groups with every edge crossing between them (bipartite graphs, keeping people who dislike each other apart): BFS paints neighbours opposite colours, and a neighbour with the same colour means an odd cycle, so the answer is no. The graph may be disconnected, so every uncoloured node starts its own search. LC 785 (Is Graph Bipartite?), LC 886 (Possible Bipartition).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(V + E) · 空间 O(V)

pattern.zh: Tarjan 求桥：low 值越不过父结点
pattern.en: Tarjan bridges: low cannot climb past the parent

when.zh: 找「删掉就断开」的边或点（关键连接、割点）：DFS 记每个点的发现时间 disc，low 是子树经一条回边能到的最早发现时间；子结点 v 的 low[v] > disc[u] 时，边 u-v 就是桥。LC 1192 查找集群内的关键连接。递归很深时 Python 要调大递归上限。
when.en: To find edges (or nodes) whose removal disconnects the graph, such as critical connections or articulation points: DFS records each node's discovery time disc, and low is the earliest discovery time its subtree reaches through one back edge. When a child v has low[v] > disc[u], the edge u-v is a bridge. LC 1192 (Critical Connections in a Network). Deep graphs need a higher recursion limit in Python.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(V + E) · 空间 O(V + E)
complexity.en: O(V + E) time · O(V + E) space

pattern.zh: DFS 三色标记：灰色是当前路径
pattern.en: Three-colour DFS: grey is the current path

when.zh: 用 DFS 判环或找「走不到环」的点：白色没访问，灰色在当前递归路径上，黑色已经确认安全；DFS 时碰到灰色就是回到了路径上，也就是有环。LC 802 找到最终的安全状态、LC 207 课程表的 DFS 写法。
when.en: To detect cycles, or find nodes that can never reach one, with DFS: white is unvisited, grey is on the current recursion path, black is finished and known safe. Meeting a grey node means returning to the path, which is a cycle. LC 802 (Find Eventual Safe States) and the DFS take on LC 207 (Course Schedule).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(V + E) · 空间 O(V)

pattern.zh: 拓扑序上做 DP：最长路径 / 最少学期
pattern.en: DP along a topological order: longest path, fewest terms

when.zh: 依赖关系构成 DAG、要算「最早什么时候能做完」「最长链有多长」：按 Kahn 的出队顺序推进，每处理一条边 u→v 就用 term[u] + 1（或加上 u 的耗时）更新 term[v]。LC 1136 并行课程；LC 2050 并行课程 III 把 +1 换成课程时长。
when.en: When dependencies form a DAG and the question is the earliest finishing time or the longest chain: follow Kahn's dequeue order and, for each edge u→v, update term[v] from term[u] + 1 (or plus u's duration). LC 1136 (Parallel Courses); LC 2050 (Parallel Courses III) swaps the +1 for course durations.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(V + E) · 空间 O(V + E)
complexity.en: O(V + E) time · O(V + E) space

code.python:
from collections import deque


def min_semesters(n: int, relations: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> int:
    """Courses 1..n, (a, b): a before b, any number per term. Fewest terms, or -1 on a cycle (LC 1136)."""
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    indeg = [0] * (n + 1)
    for a, b in relations:
        graph[a].append(b)
        indeg[b] += 1
    term = [1] * (n + 1)  # term[v]: the earliest term v can be taken
    q = deque(v for v in range(1, n + 1) if indeg[v] == 0)
    done = 0
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        done += 1
        for v in graph[u]:
            term[v] = max(term[v], term[u] + 1)  # DP in topological order: u is final when it leaves
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:
                q.append(v)
    return max(term[1:]) if done == n else -1

pattern.zh: 隐式图 BFS：状态即结点
pattern.en: BFS on an implicit graph: states are nodes

when.zh: 边权都是 1 时不用 Dijkstra：状态（密码锁的四位数、单词、棋盘）就是结点，「一步能到的状态」现场生成，BFS 第一次到达就是最短。用一个 dist 表同时记「见过」和距离。LC 752 打开转盘锁、LC 127 单词接龙、LC 773 滑动谜题。
when.en: With every edge costing 1, Dijkstra is unnecessary: each state (a lock's four digits, a word, a board) is a node, the states one move away are generated on the spot, and BFS reaches each one first by a shortest path. One dist map records both "seen" and the distance. LC 752 (Open the Lock), LC 127 (Word Ladder), LC 773 (Sliding Puzzle).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(状态数 × 每个状态的邻居数) · 空间 O(状态数)
complexity.en: O(states × moves per state) time · O(states) space

pattern.zh: 限制边数的 Bellman-Ford
pattern.en: Bellman-Ford with a limit on edges

when.zh: 最短路限定「最多经过 k 站」（或图里有负权边）时，Dijkstra 不再适用：做 k + 1 轮松弛，每轮只从上一轮的结果出发，这样第 i 轮恰好代表最多 i 条边。LC 787 K 站中转内最便宜的航班。不限轮数、跑满 V - 1 轮就是普通 Bellman-Ford，还能再跑一轮检测负环。
when.en: When a shortest path may use at most k stops (or edges can be negative), Dijkstra no longer fits: run k + 1 rounds of relaxation, each starting from the previous round's prices, so round i means at most i edges. LC 787 (Cheapest Flights Within K Stops). Without the limit, V - 1 rounds is plain Bellman-Ford, and one more round detects a negative cycle.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(k × E) · 空间 O(V)

code.python:
def cheapest_within(n: int, flights: list[tuple[int, int, int]], src: int, dst: int, k: int) -> int:
    """Cheapest price from src to dst with at most k stops, i.e. k + 1 flights (LC 787)."""
    INF = float("inf")
    dist = [INF] * n
    dist[src] = 0
    for _ in range(k + 1):  # after round i: best prices using at most i flights
        prev = dist[:]  # relax from last round only, so each round adds at most one flight
        for u, v, w in flights:
            if prev[u] + w < dist[v]:
                dist[v] = prev[u] + w
    return -1 if dist[dst] == INF else dist[dst]

pattern.zh: 状态压缩 BFS：(结点, 已访问集合)
pattern.en: Bitmask BFS: (node, visited set)

when.zh: 要求「走遍所有点」的最短路，而点数很少（n ≤ 12 左右）：状态是 (当前结点, 已访问集合的位掩码)，所有起点一起入队做多源 BFS，第一次出现全 1 掩码时的步数就是答案。LC 847 访问所有节点的最短路径。
when.en: For the shortest walk that visits every node when there are only a few (n up to about 12): the state is (current node, bitmask of visited nodes), every start goes into the queue at once for a multi-source BFS, and the first time a full mask appears gives the answer. LC 847 (Shortest Path Visiting All Nodes).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(2^n × n²) · 空间 O(2^n × n)
complexity.en: O(2^n × n²) time · O(2^n × n) space

code.python:
from collections import deque


def shortest_path_all_nodes(graph: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    """Length of the shortest walk that visits every node; edges may repeat (LC 847)."""
    n = len(graph)
    full = (1 << n) - 1
    seen = [[False] * (1 << n) for _ in range(n)]  # state (node, mask of visited nodes)
    q = deque()
    for i in range(n):  # every node is a start, at distance 0
        seen[i][1 << i] = True
        q.append((i, 1 << i))
    steps = 0
    while q:
        for _ in range(len(q)):
            u, mask = q.popleft()
            if mask == full:
                return steps
            for v in graph[u]:
                nxt = mask | 1 << v
                if not seen[v][nxt]:
                    seen[v][nxt] = True
                    q.append((v, nxt))
        steps += 1
    return -1

pattern.zh: 稠密图 Prim：O(n²) 不用堆
pattern.en: Prim on a dense graph: O(n²), no heap

when.zh: 完全图或边数接近 n² 时（LC 1584 连接所有点的最小费用），先列出所有边再给 Kruskal 排序要 O(n² log n)；Prim 每次从树外挑距离最近的点加入、再用它更新其他点的距离，用数组扫一遍就是 O(n²)，也不用把边存下来。
when.en: On a complete graph, or one with close to n² edges (LC 1584, Min Cost to Connect All Points), listing every edge and sorting it for Kruskal costs O(n² log n). Prim adds the nearest outside node each round and updates the others' distances from it; with a plain array scan that is O(n²) and stores no edges.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n²) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
def min_cost_connect(points: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    """Minimum spanning tree weight of all points under Manhattan distance (LC 1584)."""
    n = len(points)
    dist = [float("inf")] * n  # dist[v]: cheapest edge from the tree to v so far
    dist[0] = 0
    in_tree = [False] * n
    total = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        u = min((v for v in range(n) if not in_tree[v]), key=lambda v: dist[v])  # nearest outside node
        in_tree[u] = True
        total += dist[u]
        for v in range(n):
            if not in_tree[v]:
                d = abs(points[u][0] - points[v][0]) + abs(points[u][1] - points[v][1])
                dist[v] = min(dist[v], d)
    return total

pattern.zh: 一层层剥叶子找树的中心
pattern.en: Peel leaves layer by layer to find the centre

when.zh: 问以哪个点为根树最矮（LC 310 最小高度树）：把度为 1 的叶子一圈圈剥掉，像拓扑排序一样，剩下的最后 1 到 2 个点就是中心。每个点进出队列一次，O(n)；不用从每个点都 BFS 一遍。
when.en: To find the roots that make a tree shortest (LC 310, Minimum Height Trees): peel the degree-1 leaves off layer by layer, much like a topological sort, and the last one or two nodes left are the centres. Each node enters and leaves once, O(n), instead of a BFS from every node.

pattern.zh: 选或不选：每个下标二选一
pattern.en: Pick or skip: two branches per index

when.zh: 元素互不相同、要列出所有子集时，最直接的写法是在每个下标上分两支：不选它、选它，走到末尾就是一个子集。LC 78 子集、LC 784 字母大小写全排列都是这个形状。
when.en: With distinct elements and every subset wanted, the plainest shape branches twice at each index (skip it, take it), and reaching the end yields one subset. LC 78 (Subsets) and LC 784 (Letter Case Permutation) have this shape.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · 2^n) · 递归深度 O(n)

code.python:
def subsets(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every subset of distinct nums."""
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(i: int) -> None:
        if i == len(nums):
            res.append(path[:])  # one leaf per subset
            return
        dfs(i + 1)  # skip nums[i]
        path.append(nums[i])
        dfs(i + 1)  # take nums[i]
        path.pop()

    dfs(0)
    return res

pattern.zh: 组合：从 start 往后选，剪掉凑不满的分支
pattern.en: Combinations: choose from start on, prune short branches

when.zh: 只要固定大小 k 的组合：每层从 start 往后选，选够 k 个就记录；剩下的数不够凑满 k 个时直接停。LC 77 组合、LC 216 组合总和 III 都用这个剪枝。
when.en: For combinations of a fixed size k: each level picks from start onwards and records once k are chosen, and it stops as soon as too few numbers are left to finish. LC 77 (Combinations) and LC 216 (Combination Sum III) use this pruning.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(k · C(n, k)) · 递归深度 O(k)
complexity.en: O(k · C(n, k)) time · O(k) recursion depth

code.python:
def combine(n: int, k: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every k-number combination of 1..n, each in increasing order."""
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(start: int) -> None:
        if len(path) == k:
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        for x in range(start, n - (k - len(path)) + 2):  # leave room for the rest
            path.append(x)
            dfs(x + 1)
            path.pop()

    dfs(1)
    return res

pattern.en: Combinations with reuse: recurse on the same index

when.zh: 同一个数可以选多次：递归时传 i 而不是 i + 1。先排序，候选数一旦超过剩余目标就 break，后面更大的数也不用试。LC 39 组合总和就是这一格。
when.en: When a number may be picked again: recurse with i instead of i + 1. Sort first so that once a candidate exceeds the remaining target the loop breaks, since every later one is larger. LC 39 (Combination Sum) is this cell.

complexity.zh: 时间指数级，取决于 target / min · 递归深度 O(target / min)

when.zh: 输入里有重复数字、每个只能用一次、答案不能重复：排序后同一层遇到和前一个相同的值就跳过，递归传 i + 1。LC 40 组合总和 II 就是这一格。
when.en: With repeated numbers, each used once and no duplicate answers: sort, skip a value equal to the previous one on the same level, and recurse with i + 1. LC 40 (Combination Sum II) is this cell.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · 2^n) · 递归深度 O(n)

pattern.zh: 排列：used 数组标记已放的元素
pattern.en: Permutations: a used array marks placed elements

when.zh: 顺序不同算不同答案时，每层都从头扫一遍，跳过已经用过的位置。LC 46 全排列就是这一格；每层换一组候选（LC 17 电话号码的字母组合）也是同一个骨架。
when.en: When order matters, every level scans from the start and skips positions already used. LC 46 (Permutations) is this cell; LC 17 (Letter Combinations of a Phone Number) is the same skeleton with a new set of choices per level.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · n!) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
def permute(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every ordering of distinct nums."""
    res, path, used = [], [], [False] * len(nums)

    def dfs() -> None:
        if len(path) == len(nums):
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        for i, x in enumerate(nums):
            if used[i]:
                continue  # each element appears once per ordering
            used[i] = True
            path.append(x)
            dfs()
            path.pop()
            used[i] = False

    dfs()
    return res

pattern.zh: 排列有重复：相同值按原顺序放
pattern.en: Permutations with duplicates: equal values in input order

when.zh: 输入有重复、排列不能重复：排序后规定相同的值只能按输入顺序放，前一个相同值还没用时跳过当前这个。LC 47 全排列 II、LC 1079 活字印刷都靠这一行去重。
when.en: With repeats in the input and no repeated orderings: sort, and let equal values be placed only in input order, skipping one while the equal value before it is unused. LC 47 (Permutations II) and LC 1079 (Letter Tile Possibilities) rely on that one line.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n · n!) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
def permute_unique(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Every distinct ordering when nums has repeats."""
    nums = sorted(nums)
    res, path, used = [], [], [False] * len(nums)

    def dfs() -> None:
        if len(path) == len(nums):
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if used[i] or (i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i - 1] and not used[i - 1]):
                continue  # equal values are placed in input order only
            used[i] = True
            path.append(nums[i])
            dfs()
            path.pop()
            used[i] = False

    dfs()
    return res

pattern.zh: 按计数约束生成括号
pattern.en: Generate brackets under count constraints

when.zh: 每一步只有少数几种字符可选、靠计数就能剪枝（括号、IP 段数、字母大小写）：左括号还有剩就能放，右括号只在比左括号少时才能放，这样走到长度 2n 的都是合法串，不用最后再检查。LC 22 括号生成，LC 301 删除无效的括号用同样的计数。
when.en: When each step picks from a few characters and counts alone can prune (brackets, IP segments, letter case): an opening bracket fits while some are left, a closing one only while fewer have closed than opened, so everything reaching length 2n is valid with no final check. LC 22 (Generate Parentheses); LC 301 (Remove Invalid Parentheses) uses the same counts.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(4^n / √n)（卡特兰数个结果）· 递归深度 O(n)
complexity.en: O(4^n / √n) time (a Catalan number of results) · O(n) recursion depth

code.python:
def generate_parentheses(n: int) -> list[str]:
    """Every balanced string of n pairs of parentheses (LC 22)."""
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(opened: int, closed: int) -> None:
        if len(path) == 2 * n:
            res.append("".join(path))
            return
        if opened < n:  # an opening bracket fits while some are left
            path.append("(")
            dfs(opened + 1, closed)
            path.pop()
        if closed < opened:  # a closing bracket needs an unmatched opening one
            path.append(")")
            dfs(opened, closed + 1)
            path.pop()

    dfs(0, 0)
    return res

pattern.zh: 网格回溯：原地标记，回来再还原

pattern.zh: 数独：行、列、宫各用一个位掩码
pattern.en: Sudoku: one bitmask per row, column and box

when.zh: 约束满足类的填格子题（数独、八数码、24 点的变形）：把每行、每列、每宫已用的数字记成位掩码，判断「能不能放 d」只要一次与运算；按空格顺序回溯，放下时置位，退回时清位。LC 37 解数独、LC 36 有效的数独用的是同一组掩码。
when.en: For constraint-filling puzzles (Sudoku and its relatives): keep the digits used in each row, column and box as bitmasks so "can d go here" is a single AND, and backtrack over the empty cells, setting bits on the way down and clearing them on the way back. LC 37 (Sudoku Solver); LC 36 (Valid Sudoku) uses the same masks.

complexity.zh: 最坏指数级；常见题面很快 · 空间 O(81)
complexity.en: Exponential in the worst case, fast on typical puzzles · O(81) space

pattern.zh: 自顶向下记忆化递归
pattern.en: Top-down recursion with a memo

when.zh: 先写出「从 i 开始还有几种 / 最少要多少」的递归，再加一张备忘表，就是 DP 的另一种写法：转移不好排顺序、或者只有一部分状态会被用到时更顺手。LC 91 解码方法、LC 70 爬楼梯、LC 343 整数拆分都能这样写；Python 用 functools.cache。
when.en: Write the recursion for "how many ways, or how few, from position i on", then add a memo table, and you have the other way to write a DP. It is handier when the order of transitions is awkward or only some states are ever reached. LC 91 (Decode Ways), LC 70 (Climbing Stairs) and LC 343 (Integer Break) all work; in Python use functools.cache.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)（备忘表 + 递归栈）
complexity.en: O(n) time · O(n) space (memo plus recursion stack)

pattern.zh: 最大正方形：取上、左、左上三者最小再加一
pattern.en: Maximal square: one more than the min of up, left and up-left

when.zh: 求全 1 的最大正方形（或统计正方形个数）：dp 是「以 (r, c) 为右下角的最大边长」，它被上、左、左上三个方向里最短的那个限制住，所以是三者最小值加一。压成一行时用一个变量保存左上角的旧值。LC 221 最大正方形、LC 1277 统计全为 1 的正方形子矩阵。
when.en: For the largest all-1 square (or the number of squares): dp is the side of the largest square whose bottom-right corner is (r, c), limited by the shortest of up, left and up-left, so it is their minimum plus one. With one row, a variable keeps the old up-left value. LC 221 (Maximal Square), LC 1277 (Count Square Submatrices with All Ones).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(rows × cols) · 空间 O(cols)

code.python:
def maximal_square(matrix: list[str]) -> int:
    """Area of the largest all-'1' square; each row is a string such as "10111" (LC 221)."""
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    dp = [0] * (cols + 1)  # dp[c + 1]: side of the largest square ending at (r, c); dp[0] stays 0
    best = 0
    for row in matrix:
        diag = 0  # the up-left neighbour: dp[c] before this row overwrote it
        for c in range(cols):
            up = dp[c + 1]
            dp[c + 1] = min(up, dp[c], diag) + 1 if row[c] == "1" else 0  # limited by up, left, up-left
            best = max(best, dp[c + 1])
            diag = up
    return best * best

def knapsack_01(weights: list[int], values: list[int], cap: int) -> int:
    """Best total value within capacity cap, each item at most once."""
    dp = [0] * (cap + 1)  # dp[c]: best value with capacity c
    for w, v in zip(weights, values):
        for c in range(cap, w - 1, -1):  # backwards: the item is used at most once
            dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - w] + v)
    return dp[cap]

def can_partition(nums: list[int]) -> bool:
    """Can nums be split into two groups with equal sums?"""
    total = sum(nums)
    if total % 2:
        return False
    target = total // 2
    dp = [True] + [False] * target  # dp[s]: some subset sums to s
    for x in nums:
        for s in range(target, x - 1, -1):  # backwards: x is used at most once
            dp[s] = dp[s] or dp[s - x]
    return dp[target]

def min_coins(coins: list[int], amount: int) -> int:
    """Fewest coins (each reusable) that sum to amount, or -1."""
    INF = amount + 1  # more coins than any answer can need
    dp = [0] + [INF] * amount  # dp[s]: fewest coins for sum s
    for coin in coins:
        for s in range(coin, amount + 1):  # forwards: the coin may be reused
            dp[s] = min(dp[s], dp[s - coin] + 1)
    return dp[amount] if dp[amount] < INF else -1

code.python:
def bounded_knapsack(weights: list[int], values: list[int], counts: list[int], cap: int) -> int:
    """Best value within cap when item i has counts[i] copies."""
    dp = [0] * (cap + 1)
    for w, v, cnt in zip(weights, values, counts):
        k = 1
        while cnt > 0:  # bundles of 1, 2, 4, ... copies, then the rest
            take = min(k, cnt)
            cnt -= take
            k *= 2
            for c in range(cap, take * w - 1, -1):  # each bundle is one 0/1 item
                dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - take * w] + take * v)
    return dp[cap]

def longest_arith_subseq(arr: list[int], difference: int) -> int:

    best_end: dict[int, int] = {}  # value -> longest such subsequence ending with that value

        best = max(best, best_end[x])
    return best

def word_break(s: str, words: list[str]) -> bool:
    """Can s be cut into dictionary words, each usable any number of times? (LC 139)"""
    vocab = set(words)
    longest = max(map(len, words), default=0)
    ok = [True] + [False] * len(s)  # ok[i]: the prefix s[:i] can be cut
    for i in range(1, len(s) + 1):
        for j in range(max(0, i - longest), i):  # the last word is s[j:i]
            if ok[j] and s[j:i] in vocab:
                ok[i] = True
                break
    return ok[len(s)]

code.python:
def max_coins(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    """Most coins from bursting all balloons (LC 312): pick the last one burst in each range."""
    vals = [1] + nums + [1]
    n = len(vals)
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]  # dp[i][j]: best for the balloons strictly between i and j
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):  # i backwards so dp[k][j] with k > i is ready
        for j in range(i + 2, n):
            for k in range(i + 1, j):  # k goes last: its neighbours are then i and j
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + vals[i] * vals[k] * vals[j])
    return dp[0][n - 1]

pattern.zh: 环形子数组：总和减去最小子数组
pattern.en: Circular subarray: total minus the smallest subarray

when.zh: 数组首尾相连时，最大子数组要么不跨界（普通 Kadane），要么跨界：跨界的那段等于「总和减去中间一段」，中间那段取最小子数组和。全为负数时「总和 − 最小」对应空数组，要退回普通 Kadane 的结果。LC 918 环形子数组的最大和。
when.en: When the array wraps around, the best subarray either stays inside (plain Kadane) or wraps; a wrapping one is the total minus a middle part, so take the smallest subarray sum for that part. With all numbers negative, total minus smallest is the empty array, so fall back to plain Kadane. LC 918 (Maximum Sum Circular Subarray).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
def max_circular_subarray(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    """Largest sum of a non-empty subarray when the array wraps around (LC 918)."""
    best_max = cur_max = best_min = cur_min = total = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        cur_max = max(x, cur_max + x)  # Kadane for the largest subarray...
        best_max = max(best_max, cur_max)
        cur_min = min(x, cur_min + x)  # ...and for the smallest
        best_min = min(best_min, cur_min)
        total += x
    # Wrapping = everything but a middle part. All negative: that would be empty, so don't.
    return max(best_max, total - best_min) if best_max > 0 else best_max

pattern.zh: 两个状态：还没删 / 已经删了一个
pattern.en: Two states: nothing deleted yet / one deleted

when.zh: 允许「最多删一个 / 翻转一次 / 跳过一次」的子数组问题，给以 i 结尾的状态加一维：keep 是还没用掉机会，dropped 是已经用掉。dropped 要么是删掉 x 本身（接上旧的 keep），要么是早删过、现在接上 x。LC 1186 删除一次得到子数组最大和；LC 1911、LC 926 也是这类两三个状态互相转移。
when.en: For subarray problems that allow one deletion, flip or skip, add a dimension to the state ending at i: keep has the chance unused, dropped has used it. dropped either deletes x itself (taking the old keep) or deleted earlier and now extends with x. LC 1186 (Maximum Subarray Sum with One Deletion); LC 1911 and LC 926 also pass between two or three states.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

code.python:
def max_sum_one_deletion(arr: list[int]) -> int:
    """Largest sum of a non-empty subarray with at most one element deleted (LC 1186)."""
    keep = best = arr[0]  # keep: best sum ending here with nothing deleted
    dropped = float("-inf")  # best sum ending here with one element deleted
    for x in arr[1:]:
        dropped = max(keep, dropped + x)  # delete x (old keep), or extend an earlier deletion
        keep = max(x, keep + x)
        best = max(best, keep, dropped)
    return best

pattern.zh: 最多 k 笔交易：buy[j] / sell[j] 两组状态
pattern.en: At most k trades: buy[j] and sell[j] states

when.zh: 交易次数有上限（最多 2 笔、最多 k 笔）时，状态按「第几笔」展开：buy[j] 是第 j 笔买入后手上的最好余额，sell[j] 是做完 j 笔后的最好余额，每天按 j 从小到大更新一遍。LC 188 买卖股票的最佳时机 IV，LC 123 是 k = 2。
when.en: When the number of trades is capped (at most 2, at most k), unfold the state by trade number: buy[j] is the best balance after buying in trade j and sell[j] after completing j trades, updated for each j every day. LC 188 (Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock IV); LC 123 is k = 2.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n × k) · 空间 O(k)

pattern.zh: 手续费：持有 / 空仓两个状态
pattern.en: Transaction fee: holding and empty states

when.zh: 不限次数、只是每笔多一个手续费（或者每次卖出后什么限制都没有）时，两个状态就够：hold 是手上有股票的最好余额，free 是空仓的最好余额；卖出时扣掉手续费。LC 714 买卖股票的最佳时机含手续费；LC 122 是手续费为 0。
when.en: With unlimited trades and only a fee per trade (or no restriction at all after selling), two states are enough: hold is the best balance with a share in hand, free with none, and selling pays the fee. LC 714 (Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee); LC 122 is a fee of 0.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)

pattern.zh: 按天 DP：通行证覆盖到今天
pattern.en: Day-indexed DP: a pass covering up to today

when.zh: 时间轴不长、按天决策（买 1/7/30 天的票、按天排课）时，dp[d] 就是「到第 d 天为止的最优」：今天不出门就沿用昨天；出门就枚举最后买的那张票覆盖到今天，从票生效前一天转移过来。LC 983 最低票价；天数很大时改成只在出行日之间跳，用二分找生效日。
when.en: When the timeline is short and decisions are per day (1-, 7- or 30-day passes, day-by-day plans), dp[d] is the best up to day d: a day without travel copies yesterday, and a travel day tries each pass as the last one bought, covering today, coming from the day before it starts. LC 983 (Minimum Cost For Tickets); with a huge day range, jump between travel days and binary search the start.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(最后一天) · 空间 O(最后一天)
complexity.en: O(last day) time · O(last day) space

code.python:
def min_ticket_cost(days: list[int], costs: list[int]) -> int:
    """Cheapest 1-, 7- and 30-day passes (prices costs) covering every travel day (LC 983)."""
    travel = set(days)
    last = days[-1]
    dp = [0] * (last + 1)  # dp[d]: cheapest cover of every travel day up to day d
    for d in range(1, last + 1):
        if d not in travel:
            dp[d] = dp[d - 1]  # nothing to cover today
            continue
        dp[d] = min(
            dp[d - 1] + costs[0],
            dp[max(0, d - 7)] + costs[1],  # a 7-day pass ending today covers d-6..d
            dp[max(0, d - 30)] + costs[2],
        )
    return dp[last]

pattern.zh: 从后往前：做这一题就跳过后面几题
pattern.en: Backwards: solving one skips the next few

when.zh: 选了第 i 项就要跳过后面若干项（做题耗脑力、任务有冷却）时，从后往前算 dp[i] =「从 i 开始的最好结果」：不选就是 dp[i + 1]，选就是收益加上跳过之后的 dp。倒着推让「跳到哪里」直接是下标。LC 2140 解决智力问题。
when.en: When taking item i forces you to skip the next few (questions that drain brainpower, tasks with cooldowns), compute dp[i], the best from i onwards, back to front: skipping gives dp[i + 1], taking gives the gain plus dp after the skip. Going backwards makes "where to land" a plain index. LC 2140 (Solving Questions With Brainpower).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
def most_points(questions: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    """questions[i] = [points, brainpower]; solving i skips the next brainpower ones (LC 2140)."""
    n = len(questions)
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)  # dp[i]: best from question i on, filled back to front
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        points, skip = questions[i]
        dp[i] = max(dp[i + 1], points + dp[min(n, i + skip + 1)])  # pass on i, or solve it and jump
    return dp[0]

pattern.zh: 博弈区间 DP：存「先手比后手多几分」
pattern.en: Game interval DP: store "mover minus opponent"

when.zh: 两人轮流从两端拿、都走最优（预测赢家、石子游戏）：dp[i][j] 存当前要走的人在 nums[i..j] 上能比对手多拿多少，拿走一端后对手面对剩下的区间，所以是 nums[i] − dp[i+1][j] 和 nums[j] − dp[i][j−1] 取大。只差一维，可以压成一行。LC 486 预测赢家、LC 877 石子游戏。
when.en: For two players taking from either end in turn, both playing well (Predict the Winner, Stone Game): dp[i][j] stores how much more the player to move can get than the opponent on nums[i..j]. After taking an end, the opponent faces the rest, so it is the larger of nums[i] − dp[i+1][j] and nums[j] − dp[i][j−1], and one row is enough. LC 486 (Predict the Winner), LC 877 (Stone Game).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n²) · 空间 O(n)

pattern.zh: 单调队列优化 DP：窗口里的最大 dp
pattern.en: Monotonic-deque DP: the best dp in a window

when.zh: 转移是「从前面 k 个位置里挑 dp 最大的」（每次最多跳 k 步、带长度限制的子序列和）时，每步扫 k 个是 O(nk)；用单调队列维护窗口内的最大 dp，降到 O(n)。LC 1696 跳跃游戏 VI；LC 1425 带限制的子序列和、LC 862 是同一个队列。
when.en: When each transition takes the best dp among the previous k positions (jumps of at most k steps, constrained subsequence sums), scanning k each time is O(nk); a monotonic deque holding the window's best dp brings it to O(n). LC 1696 (Jump Game VI); LC 1425 (Constrained Subsequence Sum) and LC 862 use the same deque.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

code.python:
from collections import deque


def max_jump_score(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    """From index 0 to n - 1 in jumps of 1..k steps: the best sum of the values landed on (LC 1696)."""
    n = len(nums)
    dp = [0] * n  # dp[i]: best score landing on i
    dp[0] = nums[0]
    dq = deque([0])  # indexes in the last k, dp decreasing: the front is the best place to jump from
    for i in range(1, n):
        if dq[0] < i - k:
            dq.popleft()  # too far back to reach i
        dp[i] = dp[dq[0]] + nums[i]
        while dq and dp[dq[-1]] <= dp[i]:
            dq.pop()  # i is closer and no worse: they will never be the best again
        dq.append(i)
    return dp[-1]

pattern.zh: 两个栈拼一个队列：出栈空了才倒
pattern.en: A queue from two stacks: refill only when the out-stack is empty

when.zh: 只给你栈（或要用栈模拟别的容器）：新元素压进 inbox，取元素从 outbox 拿，outbox 空了才把 inbox 整个倒过去，顺序正好反过来。每个元素最多被搬一次，均摊 O(1)。LC 232 用栈实现队列；反过来用队列实现栈见 LC 225。
when.en: When only stacks are available (or a stack must stand in for another container): push new items onto inbox, take them from outbox, and pour all of inbox across only when outbox is empty, which reverses the order exactly. Each item moves at most once, so it is O(1) amortised. LC 232 (Implement Queue using Stacks); LC 225 goes the other way.

complexity.zh: 每次操作均摊 O(1) · 空间 O(n)
complexity.en: O(1) amortised per operation · O(n) space

pattern.zh: 每个元素记住「到它为止的最小值」
pattern.en: Each entry remembers the minimum up to it

when.zh: 要在 O(1) 里随时拿到栈里的最小（或最大）值：入栈时把「这个元素和它下面所有元素的最小值」一起存进去，出栈时它跟着走，不用重新算。LC 155 最小栈；同样的想法也能给队列（两个这样的栈）加上 O(1) 最值。
when.en: To read the stack's minimum (or maximum) in O(1) at any time: push each value together with the minimum of it and everything below it, so that minimum leaves with it and nothing is recomputed. LC 155 (Min Stack); two such stacks give a queue an O(1) minimum as well.

complexity.zh: 每次操作 O(1) · 空间 O(n)

pattern.zh: 对顶堆：大顶堆存较小一半，小顶堆存较大一半
pattern.en: Two heaps: a max-heap below, a min-heap above

when.zh: 数据流里随时要中位数（或第 k 小、滑动窗口中位数）：较小的一半放大顶堆，较大的一半放小顶堆，每次插入先进大顶堆、再把它的堆顶挪到小顶堆，最后保证大顶堆不比小顶堆少。中位数就在两个堆顶。LC 295 数据流的中位数。
when.en: For a running median of a stream (or the k-th smallest, or a sliding-window median): keep the smaller half in a max-heap and the larger half in a min-heap. Each insert goes into the max-heap, its top moves to the min-heap, and then the max-heap is topped up so it is never the smaller one. The median sits on the two tops. LC 295 (Find Median from Data Stream).

pattern.zh: 数组 + 下标表：删除时和末尾交换
pattern.en: Array plus index map: delete by swapping with the last

when.zh: 既要 O(1) 增删、又要 O(1) 随机取一个（或按位置访问）：值存在数组里，哈希表记每个值的下标；删除时把末尾元素搬到被删的位置、更新它的下标，再弹出末尾，数组始终没有空洞。LC 380 O(1) 时间插入、删除和获取随机元素，LC 381 允许重复。
when.en: For O(1) insert and delete plus O(1) random pick (or access by position): keep the values in an array and each value's index in a hash map. To delete, move the last element into the freed slot, update its index and pop the end, so the array never has holes. LC 380 (Insert Delete GetRandom O(1)); LC 381 allows duplicates.

complexity.zh: 每次操作平均 O(1) · 空间 O(n)
complexity.en: O(1) average per operation · O(n) space

pattern.zh: 前序 + 空结点标记的序列化
pattern.en: Preorder with null markers for serialization

when.zh: 把树存成字符串再还原（序列化、比较子树结构、去重子树）：前序遍历，空孩子写 #，逗号分隔；还原时按同样的前序顺序一个个读，读到 # 就返回空。只有前序加空标记就能唯一确定一棵树。LC 297 二叉树的序列化与反序列化；BST 可以省掉 #，见 LC 449。
when.en: To store a tree as a string and rebuild it (serialization, comparing or de-duplicating subtree shapes): walk in preorder, write # for a missing child and separate with commas; rebuild by reading tokens back in the same preorder, returning null at each #. Preorder plus null markers pins the tree down uniquely. LC 297 (Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree); a BST can drop the markers, as in LC 449.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(n)

pattern.zh: 字典树上 DFS，带着「还能改几个字母」
pattern.en: DFS over a trie carrying the changes left

when.zh: 查询不是精确匹配，而是允许通配符或恰好改一个字母（LC 676 实现一个魔法字典、LC 211 支持 . 的单词查找）：在字典树上 DFS，每层按当前字母走对应孩子；字母不同时，只有还没用掉修改机会才能走别的孩子。走到单词结尾时要求刚好改过一次。
when.en: When a lookup is not exact but allows wildcards or exactly one changed letter (LC 676, Implement Magic Dictionary; LC 211 with "."): DFS over the trie, following the child for the current letter, and step into a different child only while the one change is unused. At the end of the word, require exactly one change to have been made.

complexity.zh: 建树 O(总长度) · 查询最坏 O(26 × L²)（LC 211 的 . 通配符可能走遍整棵树）

pattern.zh: 埃氏筛：从 i² 开始划掉倍数
pattern.en: Sieve of Eratosthenes: cross out multiples from i²

when.zh: 要 1..n 里所有质数（计数、预处理最小质因子、质因数分解很多次）：每找到一个质数 i，就把 i², i² + i, … 都划掉；更小的倍数早被更小的质数划过了，所以从 i² 开始，外层也只到 √n。LC 204 计数质数；把布尔数组换成「最小质因子」数组就能 O(log n) 分解质因数。
when.en: For every prime up to n (counting them, precomputing smallest prime factors, factorising many numbers): for each prime i, cross out i², i² + i, …; smaller multiples were already crossed out by smaller primes, so start at i², and the outer loop stops at √n. LC 204 (Count Primes); storing the smallest prime factor instead of a boolean factorises any number in O(log n).

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n log log n) · 空间 O(n)
complexity.en: O(n log log n) time · O(n) space

pattern.zh: 异或抵消，再按最低不同位分组
pattern.en: XOR to cancel pairs, then split by the lowest differing bit

when.zh: 成对出现的数里找出只出现一次的那两个（LC 260）：全部异或，成对的抵消，剩下 a ^ b；它的最低位 1（x & -x）就是 a、b 不同的一位，按这一位把所有数分成两组，各自异或就得到 a 和 b。LC 136 只有一个时直接异或；LC 137 出现三次时按位计数模 3。
when.en: To find the two values that appear once among pairs (LC 260): XOR everything so pairs cancel, leaving a ^ b. Its lowest set bit (x & -x) is a bit where a and b differ, so split all numbers by that bit and XOR each group to get a and b. LC 136 with one single value is a plain XOR; LC 137, with triples, counts each bit mod 3.

complexity.zh: 时间 O(n) · 空间 O(1)
